programs.title: Darrow & Darrow
programs.desc: Three generations of women aspire to share a house, a law practice and their feelings. Claire Darrow, an idealistic lawyer, fights for what's right, regardless of whether it makes her a dime. Naomi is her mother, whose view of the law is more elastic and profitable. They clash on nearly everything, especially on the best way to raise Claire's daughter, Louise, a bright 12-year-old with an older soul.

programs.title: Darrow & Darrow: In the Key of Murder
programs.desc: A simple offer of legal advice turns into the biggest challenge of Claire's legal career when Miles' younger sister is arrested for murder. Although Claire has never tried a murder case, she works with Miles to uncover the truth behind the crime.

programs.title: Darrow & Darrow
programs.desc: Claire finds herself defending a woman already convicted of murder, while Miles questions his role as prosecuting attorney and helps her on the case.

programs.title: Witness to Murder: A Darrow Mystery
programs.desc: Attorney Claire Darrow defends her mother's former colleague in a murder case. Things get complicated when Claire's romantic interest is named as the prosecuting attorney on the case.
